subject: Post-discovery: locking a demo slot + intro to Security & Procurement
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinc.com>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinc.com, mina_haddad@redwoodinc.com
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery wrap & next step: technical deep dive

Hi Carolyn — great conversation today, thanks for the candid product and platform context. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- What we heard: primary use case is real-time inference for summarization across patient workflows (short bursts, <128 tokens) and a longer nightly batch for analytics. Security and procurement want to understand isolation, data residency, and audit logs.
- Next step: 60-90 minute technical deep dive + sandbox access. Goal: validate SSO/SAML path, discuss KV cache behavior for your short-burst pattern, and surface what a pilot would look like (throughput targets + rollback cadence).

Proposed windows (all PT): Tue Nov 16 10:00-11:30, Wed Nov 17 14:00-15:30, Thu Nov 18 09:00-10:30. I attached an .ics with my availability.

If you can, please loop Marco (security) and whoever owns procurement so we can align on evidence and commercial timing. I copied Marissa (solutions) and Mina (security partner) from our side to help with the deep dive.

Thanks — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwoodinc.com | (415) 555-0128
redwoodinc.com

Thanks Jordan — appreciate the tight recap. The Wed Nov 17 14:00 PT slot works best for the platform team. Looping in Marco (security) and procurement. A couple quick asks from our side before the deep dive: 

1) Marco would like a short evidence list we can review beforehand (SOC2 scope, retention controls, audit log examples).
2) Procurement asks if you can share a high-level pricing band for a 3-month pilot (reserved capacity vs hosted) so we have a sense before internal approvals.

Marco / Procurement — can you confirm you can make Wed 14:00 PT? If not, propose alternatives.

Cheers,

Jordan / Carolyn — looping in quick security checklist: 
- We need a SOC 2 summary + list of controls in-scope (confidentiality, availability, logging).
- Sample audit log (redacted) that shows token-level request/response metadata (timestamps, model id, request id).
- SAML metadata or the steps to configure SSO in a sandbox.

If you can drop those artifacts before the Wed session that helps speed our review. Will join the Wed slot pending calendar confirm.

Thanks, Marco

Carolyn / Marco / Procurement team — hi all, Marissa on the Solutions team here. Thanks for coordinating. Per Jordan's recap and Marco's asks, attaching the two quick artifacts we typically share ahead of a technical deep dive: 

- SOC2-summary.txt (one-page highlights: scope, auditor, log retention windows)
- Pilot-pricing-band.csv (hosted vs reserved capacity ballpark ranges for 3-month pilots)

High-level notes: for short-burst inference patterns we usually recommend Redwood Dedicated if you need consistent tail latency and data isolation; our hosted option is cheaper to start with but we can provide a reserved pilot that includes a private VPC path if procurement prefers.

Also copied Mina (security architect) who will join Wed to walk through SAML flow and sandbox steps. 

Jordan — can you publish a calendar invite for Wed Nov 17 14:00 PT and add the sandbox access doc link?

Best,
Marissa

1) We typically require a 30-day trial agreement and a PO template for pilots. Can you confirm you can accept a PO and provide a one-page trial statement of work?
2) For DocuSign, who on your side will be the contracting contact? We prefer to streamline signature so we can spin up pilot infrastructure within a week of agreement.

If you can confirm those two items, we'll finalize the slot. Looking forward to the walk-through.
